# Nutrition Plan for Marathon Training

## Daily Calorie Target
**~2,800-3,200 calories** (depending on training intensity)
- BMR: ~1,700 cal | Add 60-90% for training volume

## Macronutrient Breakdown

| Macro | % | Grams | Purpose |
|-------|---|-------|---------|
| **Carbs** | 55-60% | 385-480g | Primary fuel for endurance |
| **Protein** | 15-17% | 105-135g | Recovery & muscle repair |
| **Fat** | 20-25% | 62-89g | Hormone function & energy |

## Sample Daily Structure

**Breakfast**
- Oatmeal with banana, berries, honey
- Whole grain toast with almond butter
- Coffee or tea

**Mid-Morning Snack**
- Greek yogurt with granola
- Apple with dates

**Lunch**
- Chicken or fish (150g)
- Brown rice or pasta (1.5 cups cooked)
- Vegetables (broccoli, sweet potato)
- Olive oil drizzle

**Pre-Run Snack** (1-2 hrs before)
- Banana with honey
- Energy bar or rice cakes

**Post-Run** (within 30 mins)
- Chocolate milk or protein smoothie
- Carbs + protein ratio 3:1

**Dinner**
- Lean protein (beef, salmon, tofu) - 150g
- Quinoa or sweet potato
- Salad with olive oil dressing

**Evening Snack**
- Whole grain bread with jam
- Casein yogurt

## Key Principles

✓ **Time carbs** around workouts  
✓ **Hydrate**: 2.5-3.5L daily + electrolytes on long runs  
✓ **Load 3 days pre-race**: 70% carbs  
✓ **Whole foods first**, supplements second  
✓ **Test everything** during training

# Nutrition Plan for Muscle Building Bulk

## Daily Caloric Target
**~3,000-3,200 calories/day** (slight surplus for muscle gain)
- Adjust based on weekly weight gain (~0.5-1 kg/week is ideal)

## Macronutrient Breakdown

| Macro | Target | Notes |
|-------|--------|-------|
| **Protein** | 160-180g/day | ~2g per kg bodyweight |
| **Carbs** | 400-450g/day | Time around workouts |
| **Fat** | 90-110g/day | ~30% of total calories |

## Protein Distribution Strategy
Spread across **4-5 meals** for optimal muscle protein synthesis:
- **Each meal: 30-40g protein** (better than few large doses)

## Sample Daily Framework

**Breakfast:** Eggs, oats, berries (35g protein)
**Snack:** Greek yogurt + granola (20g protein)
**Lunch:** Chicken breast, rice, vegetables (45g protein)
**Pre/Post-Workout:** Carbs + protein shake (30g protein)
**Dinner:** Lean beef/fish, sweet potato, vegetables (40g protein)

## Key Foods to Prioritize
- Lean proteins: Chicken, fish, turkey, lean beef, eggs
- Carbs: Oats, rice, pasta, sweet potatoes, whole grain bread
- Fats: Olive oil, avocado, nuts, fatty fish
- Vegetables: Broccoli, spinach, peppers (micronutrients)

## Pro Tips
✓ Track intake for 2 weeks to calibrate
✓ Prioritize compound lifts + adequate sleep
✓ Stay hydrated (3-4L water daily)

# Nutrition Plan for Basketball Performance & Recovery

## Daily Calorie Needs
Approximately **2,800-3,200 calories** depending on training intensity (you're likely lean at 6'6" / 95kg).

## Macro Targets
- **Protein: 130-160g/day** (1.4-1.7g per kg) — critical for muscle repair
- **Carbs: 380-450g/day** — fuel for court performance and glycogen replenishment
- **Fat: 80-95g/day** — hormonal health and joint support

## Priority Foods

### Protein (vegetarian sources)
- Greek yogurt, cottage cheese
- Eggs & egg whites
- Lentils, chickpeas, black beans
- Tofu, tempeh
- Protein powder (whey or plant-based)
- Nuts, seeds, nut butters

### Carbs (for performance)
- Oats, brown rice, quinoa
- Sweet potatoes, regular potatoes
- Whole grain bread/pasta
- Fruits (bananas, berries, dates)

### Fats & micronutrients
- Olive oil, avocado
- Nuts and seeds
- Leafy greens (iron/magnesium)
- Berries (antioxidants for recovery)

## Timing
- **Pre-game/practice:** Carbs + moderate protein 2-3 hours before
- **Post-game/practice:** Protein + carbs within 30-60 min (recovery window)
- **Daily:** 3 meals + 1-2 snacks

Consider consulting a sports dietitian for a personalized plan.
